movies.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
movies.description: A legendary concierge and his trusted lobby boy become entangled in the theft of a priceless Renaissance painting and a battle over an enormous family fortune.

movies.title: Blade Runner 2049
movies.description: A young blade runner uncovers a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos, leading him on a hunt for a man missing for thirty years.

movies.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
movies.description: An exhausted laundromat owner is swept into an insane adventure where she alone can save existence by exploring other universes and the lives she could have lived.

movies.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
movies.description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a drifter and a rebellious warrior flee from a tyrannical cult leader across a blistering desert in an armored war rig.

movies.title: Parasite
movies.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
movies.description: Teen Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his universe and must join with five counterparts from other dimensions to stop a threat to all reality.
